pkgmetadata.longdescription: OpenVINO is a toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference. It supports CPU, GPU (via OpenCL), and NPU targets, with frontends for ONNX, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and PaddlePaddle models.

use.flag: Build the OpenCL-based GPU inference plugin (works with Intel, AMD, and other OpenCL-capable GPUs)
